items.title: Barrow Vows to ‘Retire’ Darboe From Politics, Praises Faal for Joining His Coalition
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh President Adama Barrow said Saturday that he intended to force his longtime political rival, Ousainou Darboe, into retirement at the December presidential election, while praising Essa Mbye Faal for what he described as a wise decision to join his governing co...
